# agentprint plugins

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from agentprint's code; edit that, not this file. -->

agentprint 0.1.1 packaged the native way for each AI coding agent. Every hook here runs
`uvx --from agentprint==0.1.1 agentprint guard --agent <agent>` in that agent's own hook
format: the same entry `agentprint install` writes. Use the plugin or `agentprint install` for
an agent, not both.

| Folder | For | Install |
|---|---|---|
| this folder | Claude Code | `claude plugin marketplace add adighatakdas-cloud/agentprint` |
| `codex/` | Codex | `codex plugin marketplace add adighatakdas-cloud/agentprint` |
| `copilot/` | GitHub Copilot CLI | `copilot plugin marketplace add adighatakdas-cloud/agentprint` |
| `cursor/` | Cursor | copy to `~/.cursor/plugins/local/agentprint` |
| `antigravity/` | Antigravity | `agy plugin install <this folder>/antigravity` |
| `hermes/` | Hermes Agent | copy to `~/.hermes/plugins/agentprint` |
| `gemini/` | Gemini CLI (context file; manifest at the repo root) | `gemini extensions install https://github.com/adighatakdas-cloud/agentprint` |

Details: https://adighatakdas-cloud.github.io/agentprint/plugins/
